You are asked to edit the content of the .md files in the `docs/` directory.

First make sure to edit only the files within the `docs/` directory. Do not edit any files outside of this directory.
Only edit .md files. Ask to edit content in html files only if explicitly asked to do so.

This project uses jekyll and a custom rendering engine build ontop the layout attributes added to eigther
Header elements or HR Elements. All following elements are SubElements of the element above.

Use the elements you find within other md files.

Important: There must not be spaces between Elements and the {: } attributes.

If taskted to updated a page to a new content the content provided might be only snippets or keywords.
If so create text and optimized sections (adding accordion elemnts if necessary) to create a good user experience.

If asked to fully adjust the content to the new keywords remove all content not fitting within the new keywords and rewrite
the content to fit the new keywords. You are allowed to remove whole sections or add new sections to fit the new keywords.

If tasked to update colors or styles, reject it as it is not your task to change styles or colors. Just perform
the content updates as requested.
